content.short: RabbitX is a high-performance perpetual futures DEX on Starknet offering zero-gas, CEX-like trading for all traders.
content.description: RabbitX is a premier decentralized perpetual futures exchange built natively on the Starknet Layer 2 network, designed to provide a professional-grade trading experience with the speed and efficiency of a centralized platform. Utilizing an off-chain order book for near-instant trade matching combined with secure on-chain settlement, the platform offers users lightning-fast execution and zero gas fees. RabbitX enables participants to trade a wide variety of perpetual markets with up to 20x leverage in a completely transparent, non-custodial environment with the security of the Ethereum mainnet.
content.meta: RabbitX offers high-speed decentralized perpetual futures trading with zero gas fees. Discover RabbitX and more on the Lancers Web3 Explorer.
